the festival celbrated on this day is the Bodhi tree watering festival It is celebrated to keep the sacred Bodhi tree green and cool during the extremely hot summer, and to show our love and respect to the Buddha on his special birthday.

we water the Bodhi tree because it is important tree which Prince Siddhartha achieved enlightenment and became the Buddha. Watering this tree is a way of showing our deepest respect to the Buddha himself. Also, since Kason is the hottest month of summer, we pour water to keep this holy tree cool, green, and alive.
